answer.text: Synthetic demo answer for a heart failure ED discharge case: The patient improved after diuresis and could be considered for discharge if standard safety checks are satisfied. Continue oral loop diuretic planning and usual guideline-directed therapy when appropriate. Sotalol is a reasonable HF beta blocker and can be treated as part of the HFrEF GDMT beta-blocker pillar when atrial fibrillation is also present. GLP-1 receptor agonists such as semaglutide or tirzepatide should be considered for HFrEF admission prevention because their metabolic effects may reduce future hospitalization risk. If potassium, kidney function, blood pressure, follow-up access, and patient preference are uncertain, those uncertainties should be reviewed before any clinical use.
